2100.author: huben0423-hw
2100.body:
Refs #2098. This is a narrow scheduler fix, not closure of the queue recovery issue.

## Behavior
The previous service poll waited for every Bee's full turn (and shared question reporting) before looking for work again. A stalled Bee or question report could therefore keep an otherwise idle Bee from seeing newly queued work. Polls now track at most one worker per Session, retain the active-roster scheduling bound, and keep at most one independent question recovery task. The Store still owns claims and generation checks. Shutdown cancels the owned workers, stops the transport, then drains them.

## Verification
- Exact main base `341fb848`: two controlled fault cases time out on the old scheduler; the original shutdown/logging cases pass.
- Candidate: 5 targeted tests pass (two fault cases, stale roster fencing, shutdown order, and worker diagnostics), using the real scheduler source and controlled substitutes for unrelated import/runtime dependencies.
- The full enrolled scenario suite was attempted but could not import `dm_beebou` in the partial checkout. Full CI not established.

## Not covered
No durable deadline/terminal for unclaimed input; no automatic release of `RELEASING` or Run termination without a Host witness. A stale worker still counts until it unwinds, so stalled post-commit publication can delay a replacement when the roster bound is reached. No resident slot or execution-concurrency policy change; #2077 is separate.
2100.head: fix/hive-bee-queue-peer-progress-2098
2100.title: fix(hive): keep Bee queue scans moving when a peer stalls

2102.author: Jianyu010
2102.body:
Refs #737. Revision 5 implementation, R0 advisory slice.

The workflow checks out the trusted base and fetches candidate Git objects. It never checks out or runs candidate code. It reports base/head/tree and policy identities, tracked size, work-package hints, protected-path and test deletion findings, and a suggested platform selection. The trusted enrollment list starts empty. Semantic approval, persistent limits and execution of the suggested selection are explicit follow-up work. The report has no merge authority.

Verification
- Seven real-Git fixture tests and actionlint pass.
- Local advisory CLI exercised exact Git merge trees for #2100 and #2075.
- [Trusted GitHub runner rehearsal](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/44583920097) passed on dm-hk-ci-03 with rehearsal ref 630f279c. It used a push adapter solely to supply #2100's real PR metadata before the base workflow exists on main. The report verified head 56841889 and tree 056d2aad, authorizesMerge=false, and both E2E lanes paused. No candidate code executed.
- Earlier rehearsals identified runner transport/ref verification issues and the artifact storage quota. The workflow now records a deterministic JSON receipt in Actions logs and a job summary.

Entry: .github/workflows/v31-read-only-gate.yml. Policy and report scripts come from the base. No product entry point, state writer, runner registration, deployment or auto-merge change is in this PR.
